title: authEnvSchema for auth.admin and auth.mail
detail: authEnvSchema declares APP_BASE_URL, AUTH_ADMIN_EMAIL and AUTH_ADMIN_PASSWORD with descriptions and the pulumi secret marker; an app spreads its shape into its env schema.

title: Boot warning when anonymous routes run without anonymousAccess
detail: A boot warning names anonymousAccess when host-routing, managed-pages or legal-pages is mounted without it; anonymous requests get no tenant until the option is set.

title: The deprecated authFoundationFeature constant is removed
detail: authFoundationFeature was kept next to createAuthFoundationFeature() for one release. Mount the feature by calling createAuthFoundationFeature().
migration: Run bun kumiko-upgrade --apply. It replaces authFoundationFeature with createAuthFoundationFeature().

title: validateSessionStoreMultiplicity accepts zero sessionStore providers (fw#1547).
detail: A machine-API-only deployment (PAT-bearer auth, no browser sessions) can mount auth-foundation without also mounting sessions.

title: Allow zero tokenVerifier when sessionStore present
detail: Auth foundation now accepts zero tokenVerifier when a sessionStore is configured — prevents crash in session-store-only setups.

title: tenantResolver/tenantExistence extension points, sessionStore without auth.sessions (fw#1372-1375).
detail: Auth-foundation migration: tenant resolution and tenant-existence become extension points, sessionStore is wired without going through auth.sessions, AnonymousAccessConfig is slimmed down. See the auth-foundation-providers recipe.
